end.summary:
Reyansh identified top, front, and side views of common solids.
They matched views to objects accurately across the practice questions.
They explained that cones look triangular from the side and cylinders rectangular.
They initially thought another person would see the same cup handle, then corrected this using obstruction examples.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised top, front, and side views with Reyansh, including cubes, cones, cylinders, cups, and a sports field. They used object features and shape comparisons to match views, and the cup-handle mix-up was corrected later by discussing how the cup body can block the handle from another place. At home, ask Reyansh to look at one object from two sides and describe which parts are visible from each place.
